articles.summary: Richard Trahant says accusers have been vindicated after Catholic church officially classifies Paul Hart as sex abuser An attorney who was fined more than $400,000 after getting an abusive Roman Catholic priest removed as a New Orleans high school’s chaplain says it was “worth it” now that the church has officially classified the cleric as a clergy molester.
